params.name: streamID
params.description: The id of the stream you want to access. Make sure that you are URI encoding the streamId

params.name: count
params.description: The number of articles/entries to return. Pick a number between 1 and 100 (optional, default is 20)

params.name: newerThan
params.description: Long timestamp in ms representing the time of your previous call (in Unix/Epoch). Cannot be older than 31 days ago. (optional)

params.name: olderThan
params.description: Long timestamp in ms representing the time of your previous call (in Unix/Epoch). (optional)

params.name: continuation
params.description: An id is used to page through the articles. The continuation id will be returned as part of each call response. This is useful if you want to fetch more articles than the count = 100 limit (optional)

params.name: includeAiActions
params.description: if true, AI Actions from articles will be returned.

params.name: similar
params.description: if true, numRelatedEntries will be returned
